summary.plain: A planned smaller underground detector on the ESS site, 250 metres from the neutrino target, combining a water tank with a fine-grained tracker inside a magnet, to measure the beam and neutrino interaction rates.
summary.technical: Proposed 1 kt underground water-Cherenkov near detector on the ESS site 250 m from the target station, with a tracking detector of one million 1 cm^3 scintillator cubes in a dipole magnet and an emulsion stack immersed in water.
